response.title: can i leave my fridge plugged into a power station all the time
response.answer:
Yes, you can leave your refrigerator plugged into a portable power station 24/7, including while the power station itself is plugged into a wall outlet.

However, whether this is safe and practical depends on the power station's features.

What you need to check

1. UPS or EPS functionality: Ideally, the power station supports pass-through power and automatic switching to battery when grid power fails. Not all power stations support continuous operation this way.

2. Transfer time: Some power stations take 10–30 milliseconds to switch to battery. Most refrigerators can tolerate a brief interruption, but compatibility isn't guaranteed.

3. Compressor startup surge: A refrigerator might consume 100–300 watts while running but require 600–1,500+ watts momentarily when its compressor starts. Your power station must handle that surge.

4. Battery longevity: Keeping a power station connected continuously can accelerate battery aging, especially if it stays at 100% charge. An LFP (LiFePO4) battery is generally better suited to this application.

5. Heat and ventilation: Keep the power station in a dry, well-ventilated location, away from the refrigerator's exhaust heat. Follow the manufacturer's clearance requirements.

Two possible setups

Setup A — Continuous backup

The fridge runs through the power station all the time. During an outage, the battery takes over automatically if supported.

Setup B — Emergency backup only

The fridge normally plugs into the wall. You manually move its plug to the power station during an outage.

My recommendation: Setup A is convenient if your power station is explicitly rated for continuous pass-through/UPS operation and can handle your refrigerator's startup surge. Otherwise, Setup B is safer for the equipment.

One question

What brand and model is your power station? (For example, EcoFlow DELTA 2, Jackery Explorer 2000 Plus, or Bluetti AC200L.)

I can tell you whether that specific model is suitable for keeping your refrigerator connected 24/7, and whether doing so will shorten its battery life.
